risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (411.84) with flat yield curve, imminent CPI event, and earnings in 21 days creates severe macro headwinds for ITW.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic RSI, Williams %R) combined with early momentum recovery signals and contrarian congressional buying in a fear-zone market present a classic bounce setup.
